# Classical steganalysis photo fixture

`cc0_spruce_forest.jpg` is a small Wikimedia Commons thumbnail of “Spruce
forest at Holma” by W.carter. The image is marked CC0 / Public Domain
Dedication; it is used only as a natural-photo test fixture, not as training
data or a benchmark.

Source: <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Spruce_forest_at_Holma.jpg>
